Title: Patrologiae Cursus Completus, Series Latina, tomus LXXXIII (Sancti Isidori Hispalensis
    episcopi Opera omnia, tomi quintus, sextus et septimus)
Creator: Isidore of Seville (c. 560-636) (J.-P. Migne, compiler)
Publisher: Paris, Migne, 1860
Rights: Public Domain
Rights basis: 1860 publication, out of US copyright by date; the item carries no copyright field of
    its own, so the imprint date is the basis, read directly 2026-10-23. The host's date
    field reads 1844; the volume's own text refers to the series prospectus of December
    1860.
Language: lat
Source: Internet Archive item patrologiaecursu0083mign
    (archive.org/details/patrologiaecursu0083mign), fetched directly (curl, raw bytes)
    from the item's own _djvu.txt full-text file, 2026-10-23, Library thread (Era III).
Provenance note: Raw, uncorrected djvu OCR (rough but readable). Runs of 2+ spaces collapsed to one; no
    wording changed. Sections: Migne columns; the Historia de regibus Gothorum at raw line
    ~117639. Credit line for a reader-facing page: "Patrologia Latina 83 (Migne)". Whole
    text republishable.
Content note: Isidore's Sentences, his treatise on the church's offices, the Synonyma, his monastic
    rule, the letters and the History of the Goths, Vandals and Sueves. No public-domain
    English of these exists (Donini and Ford 1966 is in copyright).
